Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 (and v2.2.9 before it) were healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production — in all regions. The rollback completed successfully (`status: rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0002** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback. The on-call engineer was paged. (The first attempt timed out, so I verified no incident existed and retried successfully.)

Note: I did not deploy any new version, so no change-manager approval was required.
